description: This file defines the VendorCacheManager class which manages an Infinispan cache for vendor-related data within the CMS module of the project. It encapsulates cache initialization and singleton access logic.

classes.name: VendorCacheManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing an Infinispan cache for vendor data, initializing it with a configuration file, and providing access to the cache manager instance.

methods.name: VendorCacheManager
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the Infinispan cache manager with a specific configuration file.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Public static method to retrieve the singleton instance of VendorCacheManager.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the embedded cache manager instance managed by this class.
